scope: Verbatim secondary descriptions for newly reviewed bodies. Form quotations describe appearance; scope quotations are restrictions only and must not invent body details. Generated art still requires comparison to exact reference pixels. No new source images or native frames supplied.

constraints.phase: Duel humain à la tronçonneuse mentionné, sans dimensions exactes ni géométrie de la scie à ciseaux établie.
constraints.excerpt: Thankfully this is still Resident Evil, so while your first couple of boss fight with Jack is him in his humanoid form (including a chainsaw duel!), his final battle in the base game ends up turning Jack into a writhing mass of black fungal matter around the size of a small car, as he undulates like some sort of giant noodle-centipede within a warehouse.

constraints.phase: End of Zoe, Swamp Man seulement ; comparaison artistique de l’auteur conservée comme commentaire.
constraints.excerpt: In the 'End of Zoe' DLC, turns out that Jack's remains aren't even dead after three fights -- he has been transformed into the ' Swamp Man ', which is... honestly a bit of an obvious ripoff of DC's Swamp Thing or Marvel's Man-Thing.

constraints.phase: Marguerite mutée, pas la forme humaine.
constraints.excerpt: Her arms and legs have elongated so much and she crawls around walls and ceilings like a spider, and it's so unsettling to see an otherwise still-humanoid anatomy.

constraints.phase: Lucas muté, DLC Not a Hero ; commentaire d’apparence, pas un répertoire de gestes.
constraints.excerpt: The only real interesting thing is the huge mouth on his left hand, but ultimately if I can call one design 'a generic Resident Evil monster', this would be it.

constraints.phase: Apparence enfant d’Eveline ; ne pas appliquer à son corps final.
constraints.excerpt: Eveline has two humanoid forms, though the one she wants us to see is the shape of a little girl.

constraints.phase: Dernier combat, masse fongique finale d’Eveline ; le contexte est conservé dans la citation associée.
constraints.excerpt: She's also got her screaming human face in the middle of it.

constraints.phase: Dernier combat, forme finale seulement.
constraints.excerpt: In her final boss encounter has her transform into a giant flesh-glob. Mycelium-blob?

constraints.phase: DLC Not a Hero, WM-002 ; ne pas recolorer les Molded du jeu principal.
constraints.excerpt: WM-002 'Fumer' is covered in fully white mycelia, being fuzzier and with more exposed flesh and a skull-like face.

constraints.phase: DLC Not a Hero, Mama Mold WM-001 seulement.
constraints.excerpt: The host of the 'WM' is WM-001, Mama Mold... who doesn't really get much context beyond being a bigger, stronger White-Mold Molded.

constraints.excerpt: The 'Large Lycan' seen on the right are smart enough to cobble together a makeshift set of armour and two arm-mounted... how do you describe those? Masses of planks of wood and jagged scrap metal?

constraints.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.
constraints.excerpt: The Samcă are basically Moroaică with wings instead of arms, but that's kind of oversimplifying things.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.
constraints.excerpt: These guys, the Haulers, are the lowest of the low, shambling around with a set of steampunk VR goggles that are apparently used to stabilize their neural activity.

constraints.phase: Soldat Eins décrit dans la section Eins & Zwei ; un seul bras à foreuse, pas les deux de Zwei.
constraints.excerpt: Oh, and they have a giant fucking mean-looking industrial drill grafted onto their arms.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.
constraints.excerpt: The Soldat Zwei does feel like an upgrade, because of the very simple fact that both his arms are replaced with drills.

constraints.phase: Propriété collective des trois filles nommées Bela, Cassandra et Daniela ; aucune couleur ou morphologie individuelle déduite.
constraints.excerpt: But then come the revelation that the three daughters weren't exactly human, or reanimated corpses, but rather, well... a literal mass of Cadou parasites that take the form of hundreds of blowflies, and, when combined with the Mold, ends up re-merging together into the form of their humanoid hosts.

constraints.excerpt: Uriaș Străjer ("Sentinel Giant") has a big fuck-off mace with pretty cool spikes, he wears a wolf mask and has more prominent parasite tentacles growing out of him.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.
constraints.excerpt: It's hard to realize what's going on here, but Heisenberg has replaced Sturm ("storm" in German) entire upper half of this Soldat's body with a motherfucking airplane engine, complete with a spinning rotor.

constraints.phase: Moreau sous le manteau, description extérieure du commentaire seulement.
constraints.excerpt: The third of the Four Lords is Salvatore Moreau, a hunchbacked simpleton that seemed to draw on the trope of horror villains like Igor, though his name also is a nod on the classic story Island of Doctor Moreau , which features animal-human hybrids.

constraints.phase: Moreau après retrait du manteau ; ne pas confondre avec la forme pisciforme du boss.
constraints.excerpt: It's not a hunchback, Moreau is just a mass of pretty nasty-looking cysts, pustules and tumours.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.
constraints.excerpt: Taking the 'Ganado' epithet rather literally, these Brutes walk around with giant cow heads covering their heads.

constraints.phase: Première mutation, jambes humaines encore présentes ; ne pas attribuer à la seconde mutation détachée.
constraints.excerpt: I don't know how many times I can repeat this, but we keep all of the important parts of the design -- the fact that his legs still look human, that his spine has turned into a fucking centipede, and that the upper body is a combination of his human torso and head, as well as a bunch of giant bug-parts.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.
constraints.excerpt: Del Lago ("From the Lake") gets a much nastier-looking upgrade than I expected, with its salamander maw turning from being rather stretched-out into a monstrous, multi-fanged lamprey.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.
constraints.excerpt: The artwork here also makes the giant parasite sprouting of Gigante's back a bit more obvious.

constraints.phase: Colmillos commun du remake ; variante Strong Threat non déduite.
constraints.excerpt: The base wolf form now looks hideously mutated, with gigantic fangs and teeth that are way too large for the gums and mouth, making them look unnatural even before they blow apart into gigantic tentacles.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.
constraints.excerpt: The over-the-top gigantic Wolverine claws, the torture gimp mask, the exposed Plaga on his back... I guess the fact that the Garrador's eyes are sown shut is a bit more obvious in this incarnation with the higher detailing!

constraints.phase: Plaga autonome du remake ; ne pas reprendre les quatre pattes du modèle2005.
constraints.excerpt: But compared to the four-legged designs of the original RE4, the remake version goes all-in on the Alien Facehugger homage, giving the new Plaga parasites eight legs with some webbing on the most proximal end. In addition, the 'tail'-like body of the Plagas' body doesn't just trail behind it, but now curve upwards and point forwards like a scorpion.

constraints.phase: Armadura commun ; le terme presumably est une réserve de l’auteur, pas une espèce certifiée.
constraints.excerpt: The remake canonizes some additional explanation that's only told to us in supplementary material in the original game, noting that Plagas (presumably Arana) that have lost their hosts will inhabit these armoured suits, remaining dormant and stretching out their tentacles to manipulate the suit of armour when needed.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.
constraints.excerpt: The upper body looks a bit bulkier and the tail segments have some extra grooves, but that's about it.

constraints.phase: Salazar humain ; forme boss exclue.
constraints.excerpt: Probably the biggest change is that Ramon Salazar now gets changed from being a literal man-child into a short, stunted old man that wouldn't look out of place among the cast of Resident Evil VIII: Village .

constraints.phase: Forme boss mutée ; description artistique secondaire seulement.
constraints.excerpt: Most of the details are still preserved, but it's a bit more clear that it's a giant flower with Salazar sticking out of it.

constraints.phase: Regenerador commun du remake, pas la variante Strong Threat.
constraints.excerpt: Look at that slightly slouched gait, and the rubbery skin, and the lumps on his feet.

constraints.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.
constraints.excerpt: The spikes for Iron Maiden are far longer than their original version, and I love just how tortured their face looks with the added definition and pixels.

constraints.phase: Bitores Méndez muté, jeu2005 ; jugement artistique explicitement secondaire.
constraints.excerpt: It's a little boring, from a monster design perspective, that he keeps his human face intact.
